title: A unit that already starts with Unit is not prefixed again
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the organization's document design setting is the modern layout.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billed to customer B, with an asset whose Unit is "Unit 7", Year 2020, Make "Kenworth" and Model "W900".
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice's PDF.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows the invoice.

Step 3:

  • The Bill To block names customer B.
  • The band shows "Unit 7", not "Unit Unit 7".
  • The band reads "SERVICE FOR", customer A's name, "Unit 7" and "2020 Kenworth W900", separated by " · ".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12310 (Story 8, "Service For" band on invoices and estimates)

  • S8-R3: “Missing unit, year, make or model parts drop out with their separator; a unit already starting with "Unit" is not prefixed again.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.
